contract.ui: Enter/change commits; incomplete input restores previous code. Quote screen commits response only when code still matches and screen is mounted.
contract.network: Mock suffix rejection before network, no KRX fallback. Existing real-server code forwarded unchanged. Existing KST conversion; no synthetic bars or forced time shifts.
